title: Example 286's vulnerable protected-state task alone at the frozen bound, as one plain driver step that accept.py can read
description: A rerun of the vulnerable half of job 20261117-192205, which passed but which the merged examples/tools/accept.py refuses: its second step (the fixed task) ends in '|| test $? -eq 1', which is not a plain driver run, and the job did not collect the property harness the replay check now needs to see that the claim's assumption held on the witness. This job runs only examples/286-spring-framework-cve-2022-22968-case-sensitive-disallowed-fields/proofs/prove.py vulnerable-protected-state-mutation at the frozen claim's own bound (claims/protected-age-not-mutated.json, maxArrayLength 8, unwind 16, strict gaps; no trial flags) in a fresh --work folder, as one step with plain words, --timeout and one --work, and no environment, and collects the outcome, evidence.json, stderr and the harness the JVM ran (work/harness/PropertyHarness.java). Job 192205's vulnerable step refuted it in 73 s at ageAfterBinding(false, "Age"), which returns 32 on a JVM; nothing in the driver or the claim has changed since. The fixed task is not run: its blocker (non-ASCII toLowerCase at DataBinder.isAllowed:828) is recorded by job 20261117-233000. Asked by the watcher of the domain-advances run under the user's decision D036; once it passes, 286's vulnerable task's besideRoute is pointed at it and accept.py 286 rerun.
expected: exits 0 with 'verdict: violation (expected violation)' at the claim's bound 8, with a witness reproduced on a JVM (field="Age" or another case variant that binds age), and the four outputs collected

resources.notes: job 192205's vulnerable step took 73 s plus the checker's build; 2 CPUs for the JVMs the observer and the stand-ins' samplers start
